total_revenues_yoy.description: Total revenue (net interest + non-interest) YoY growth rate vs Q-4

provisions_margin_delta_bps.description: Total provisions as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

opex_margin_delta_bps.description: Total operating expenses as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

noncontrolling_interests_abs.description: noncontrolling_interests absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

discontinued_ops_loss_abs.description: discontinued_ops_loss absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
